name: forgot-password-01
title: Forgot password 01
description: One field asks for a reset link, and the answer never says whether the address has an account. The card then turns into a note that the link is on its way, with a way to send it again. Taped card, Stubby searching. Made for the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Forgot password 01" block into your components directory under blocks/forgot-password-01/.
Import it: import ForgotPassword01Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/forgot-password-01/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
